rows.description: FAST-NUCES is widely regarded as Pakistan’s foremost institution for Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence education. Established by the Foundation for Advancement of Science and Technology, FAST graduates form the core technical leadership of Pakistan’s software and technology exports.

rows.description: LUMS is Pakistan’s leading research and liberal arts university, famous for the Suleman Dawood School of Business (SDSB), the Syed Babar Ali School of Science and Engineering (SBASSE), and the Shaikh Ahmad Hassan School of Law. Operating a world-class 100-acre residential campus in Lahore, LUMS offers need-blind admissions via the National Outreach Programme (NOP).

rows.description: GIKI is one of Pakistan’s most prestigious engineering, computing, and applied science residential institutes. Situated in the foothills of the scenic Tarbela dam in Topi, KPK, GIKI provides a completely residential, immersive environment where all faculty and students reside on campus with access to world-class laboratories.

It now offers premier programs in Business Administration, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, and Accounting & Finance.

rows.title: NCEAC Minimum 50% Intermediate Baseline Rule
rows.summary: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (HSSC / FSc / ICS) or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks with Mathematics or Computer Science as major subjects.
rows.scope: All BS CS, BS SE, BS AI, BS DS, and BS Cyber Security degrees.

rows.title: IBCC Cambridge O/A-Levels Equivalence Requirement
rows.statutory_reference: IBCC Federal Act No. XXX of 2023 amended 2026
rows.summary: Candidates holding Cambridge O-Level / IGCSE and A-Level qualifications must submit an official IBCC Equivalence Certificate. Letter grades (A*, A, B, C) are converted to percentage marks via the IBCC statutory formula.
rows.scope: All international qualifications seeking admission to Pakistani higher education.
rows.formula_note: O-Level: 8 subjects required. A-Level: 3 principal subjects required.

rows.title: NUST Directorate of Admissions NET Formula Regulation
rows.summary: Merit for undergraduate computing and engineering is calculated as: 75% NUST Entry Test (NET) + 15% FSc Part-1 + 10% Matriculation / SSC.
rows.scope: NUST Islamabad (SEECS, SMME, SCME, CEME) and constituent colleges.
